question: A company uses Amazon DataZone as a data governance and business catalog solution. The company stores data in an Amazon S3 data lake. The company uses AWS Glue with an AWS Glue Data Catalog. A data engineer needs to publish AWS Glue Data Quality scores to the Amazon DataZone portal. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Create a data quality ruleset with Data Quality Definition language (DQDL) rules that apply to a specific AWS Glue table. Schedule the ruleset to run daily. Configure the Amazon DataZone project to have an Amazon Redshift data source. Enable the data quality configuration for the data source.
options.B: Configure AWS Glue ETL jobs to use an Evaluate Data Quality transform. Define a data quality ruleset inside the jobs. Configure the Amazon DataZone project to have an AWS Glue data source. Enable the data quality configuration for the data source.
options.C: Create a data quality ruleset with Data Quality Definition language (DQDL) rules that apply to a specific AWS Glue table. Schedule the ruleset to run daily. Configure the Amazon DataZone project to have an AWS Glue data source. Enable the data quality configuration for the data source.
options.D: Configure AWS Glue ETL jobs to use an Evaluate Data Quality transform. Define a data quality ruleset inside the jobs. Configure the Amazon DataZone project to have an Amazon Redshift data source. Enable the data quality configuration for the data source.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误 虽然提到了使用DQDL规则创建数据质量规则集并每天运行，但将Amazon DataZone项目配置为具有Amazon Redshift数据源是不正确 的。题目明确指出数据存储在Amazon S3数据湖中，并使用AWS Glue Data Catalog，因此数据源应该是AWS Glue，而不是Amazon Redshift。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误 此选项提到使用Evaluate Data Quality transform和定义数据质量规则集，这在技术上是可行的。然而，将Amazon DataZone项目配置为 AWS Glue数据源是正确的，但此选项没有提到使用DQDL规则集，这与题目要求不完全匹配。
explanations.C: Correct. 正确 此选项正确地提到了使用DQDL规则创建数据质量规则集，并将规则集设置为每天运行。它还正确地将Amazon DataZone项目配置为 AWS Glue数据源，并启用了数据质量配置。这完全符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误 此选项提到使用Evaluate Data Quality transform和定义数据质量规则集，但将Amazon DataZone项目配置为Amazon Redshift数据源是不正 确的。题目明确指出数据存储在Amazon S3数据湖中，并使用AWS Glue Data Catalog，因此数据源应该是AWS Glue，而不是Amazon Redshift。

question: A company has a data warehouse in Amazon Redshift. To comply with security regulations, the company needs to log and store all user activities and connection activities for the data warehouse. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Enable logging for the Amazon Redshift cluster. Specify the S3 bucket in the logging configuration to store the logs.
options.B: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Enable logging for the Amazon Redshift cluster. Write logs to the EFS file system.
options.C: Create an Amazon Aurora MySQL database. Enable logging for the Amazon Redshift cluster. Write the logs to a table in the Aurora MySQL database.
options.D: Create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Enable logging for the Amazon Redshift cluster. Write the logs to the EBS volume.

explanations.A: Correct. Amazon S3是AWS推荐的存储日志的服务，具有高可用性、持久性和成本效益。 Amazon Redshift支持将日志直接存储到S3中，包括用户活动日志和连接日志。 此选项完全符合题目要求，正确。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Amazon EFS是一个文件存储服务，主要用于共享文件系统的场景。 Redshift不支持直接将日志写入EFS，且EFS不适合存储日志数据。 此选项不符合题目要求，错误。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Amazon Aurora是一个关系型数据库服务，主要用于存储结构化数据。 Redshift不支持直接将日志写入Aurora数据库，且将日志存储在数据库中成本较高且不符合最佳实践。 此选项不符合题目要求，错误。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Amazon EBS是块存储服务，主要用于EC2实例的持久化存储。 Redshift不支持直接将日志写入EBS，且EBS不适合存储日志数据。 此选项不符合题目要求，错误。

question: A company wants to migrate a data warehouse from Teradata to Amazon Redshift. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational effort?

options.A: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) Schema Conversion to migrate the schema. Use AWS DMS to migrate the data.
options.B: Use the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to migrate the schema. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate the data.
options.C: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate the data. Use automatic schema conversion.
options.D: Manually export the schema definition from Teradata. Apply the schema to the Amazon Redshift database. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate the data.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：AWS DMS 本身不支持架构转换。架构转换需要使用 AWS Schema Conversion Tool (SCT)。 正确的工具组合应该是 SCT 用于架构转换，DMS 用于数据迁移。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确：AWS SCT 是专门设计用于将源数据库的架构转换为目标数据库的架构（例如从 Teradata 到 Redshift）。 AWS DMS 是用于迁移数据的工具，支持从 Teradata 到 Redshift 的数据迁移。 此选项使用了正确的工具组合，并且操作步骤最少。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：AWS DMS 不支持自动架构转换。架构转换需要使用 AWS SCT。 此选项忽略了架构转换的必要步骤，因此不符合要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：手动导出和应用架构定义需要额外的操作步骤，增加了操作复杂性。 此选项的操作步骤比使用 AWS SCT 和 DMS 的组合更多，因此不符合“最少操作步骤”的要求。

question: A company uses a variety of AWS and third-party data stores. The company wants to consolidate all the data into a central data warehouse to perform analytics. Users need fast response times for analytics queries. The company uses Amazon QuickSight in direct query mode to visualize the data. Users normally run queries during a few hours each day with unpredictable spikes. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon Redshift Serverless to load all the data into Amazon Redshift managed storage (RMS).
options.B: Use Amazon Athena to load all the data into Amazon S3 in Apache Parquet format.
options.C: Use Amazon Redshift provisioned clusters to load all the data into Amazon Redshift managed storage (RMS).
options.D: Use Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL to load all the data into Aurora.

explanations.A: Correct. 分析： Amazon Redshift Serverless是一种无服务器的解决方案，能够根据查询负载自动扩展资源，适合处理不可预测的查询峰值。 Redshift Serverless支持Amazon QuickSight的直接查询模式，提供快速响应时间。 使用Redshift managed storage (RMS)可以简化数据管理，降低运营开销。 此选项符合题目要求：快速响应时间、低运营开销、支持不可预测的查询峰值。 结论： 正确。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 分析： Amazon Athena是一种无服务器的查询服务，适合直接查询存储在Amazon S3中的数据。 虽然Athena支持Apache Parquet格式以优化查询性能，但它的查询响应时间通常不如Amazon Redshift，尤其是在需要高性能分析时。 Athena的查询性能可能无法满足题目中“快速响应时间”的要求。 结论： 错误。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 分析： Amazon Redshift provisioned clusters需要手动配置和管理集群资源，增加了运营开销。 虽然它可以提供高性能查询，但与Redshift Serverless相比，无法自动扩展资源以应对不可预测的查询峰值。 此选项不符合题目中“最低运营开销”的要求。 结论： 错误。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 分析： Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL是一种关系型数据库解决方案，适合事务处理而非数据仓库分析。 Aurora不适合处理大规模分析查询，查询性能和扩展性无法与Amazon Redshift相比。 此选项不符合题目中“快速响应时间”和“数据仓库”的要求。 结论： 错误。

question: A data engineer uses Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to ingest and process records that contain user behavior data from an application every day. The data engineer notices that the data stream is experiencing throttling because hot shards receive much more data than other shards in the data stream. How should the data engineer resolve the throttling issue?

options.A: Use a random partition key to distribute the ingested records.
options.B: Increase the number of shards in the data stream. Distribute the records across the shards.
options.C: Limit the number of records that are sent each second by the producer to match the capacity of the stream.
options.D: Decrease the size of the records that the producer sends to match the capacity of the stream.

explanations.A: Correct. 正确：使用随机分区键可以有效地将数据均匀分布到多个分片中，从而避免某些分片成为热点分片。 这是解决热点分片问题的推荐方法，因为分区键直接影响数据的分布。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：虽然增加分片数量可以提高数据流的吞吐量，但如果分区键没有优化，热点分片问题仍然存在。 热点分片问题的根本原因是数据分布不均，而不是分片数量不足。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：限制生产者发送的记录数量会降低数据流的整体吞吐量，并不能解决热点分片问题。 这种方法只是暂时缓解问题，而不是根本解决问题。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：减少记录大小可以降低单个分片的负载，但无法解决数据分布不均的问题。 热点分片问题的核心是分区键导致的数据分布不均，而不是记录大小。

question: A company has a data processing pipeline that includes several dozen steps. The data processing pipeline needs to send alerts in real time when a step fails or succeeds. The data processing pipeline uses a combination of Amazon S3 buckets, AWS Lambda functions, and AWS Step Functions state machines. A data engineer needs to create a solution to monitor the entire pipeline. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the Step Functions state machines to store notifications in an Amazon S3 bucket when the state machines finish running. Enable S3 event notifications on the S3 bucket.
options.B: Configure the AWS Lambda functions to store notifications in an Amazon S3 bucket when the state machines finish running. Enable S3 event notifications on the S3 bucket.
options.C: Use AWS CloudTrail to send a message to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic that sends notifications when a state machine fails to run or succeeds to run.
options.D: Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to react when the execution status of a state machine changes. Configure the rule to send a message to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic that sends notifications.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：虽然可以通过S3事件通知触发后续操作，但这种方法无法实时监控Step Functions状态机的执行状态（成功或失败）。此外，S3 事件通知的延迟可能会影响实时性要求。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：类似于选项A，这种方法依赖于S3事件通知，无法直接监控Step Functions状态机的执行状态。Lambda函数的通知存储到S3的 方式也不符合实时性要求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：虽然CloudTrail可以记录API调用，但它并不是实时监控Step Functions状态机执行状态的最佳工具。CloudTrail的日志记录通常用 于审计和合规性，而不是实时事件通知。
explanations.D: Correct. 正确：EventBridge可以实时捕获Step Functions状态机的执行状态变化（成功或失败），并通过规则将消息发送到SNS topic，从而实现 实时通知。这种方法直接满足题目要求。

question: A company has an application that uses an Amazon API Gateway REST API and an AWS Lambda function to retrieve data from an Amazon DynamoDB instance. Users recently reported intermittent high latency in the application's response times. A data engineer finds that the Lambda function experiences frequent throttling when the company's other Lambda functions experience increased invocations. The company wants to ensure the API's Lambda function operate without being affected by other Lambda functions. Which solution will meet this requirement MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Increase the number of read capacity unit (RCU) in DynamoDB.
options.B: Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function.
options.C: Configure reserved concurrency for the Lambda function.
options.D: Increase the Lambda function timeout and allocated memory.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 增加 DynamoDB 的读取容量单位 (RCU) 分析：DynamoDB 的 RCU 仅影响数据库的读取性能，与 Lambda 函数的并发问题无关。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 为 Lambda 函数配置预置并发 分析：预置并发可以确保函数在冷启动时有足够的资源，但它的成本较高，且题目要求“最具成本效益”的解决方案。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Correct. 为 Lambda 函数配置保留并发 分析：保留并发可以确保特定的 Lambda 函数有固定的并发资源，不会受到其他函数的影响。此解决方案直接解决了题目中提到 的“频繁被其他函数影响”的问题，同时成本较低。 结论：正确。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 增加 Lambda 函数的超时时间和分配内存 分析：增加超时时间和内存可以提升函数性能，但无法解决并发资源被其他函数占用的问题。 结论：错误。

question: A company has as JSON file that contains personally identifiable information (PII) data and non-PII data. The company needs to make the data available for querying and analysis. The non-PII data must be available to everyone in the company. The PII data must be available only to a limited group of employees. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Store the JSON file in an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure AWS Glue to split the file into one file that contains the PII data and one file that contains the non-PII data. Store the output files in separate S3 buckets. Grant the required access to the buckets based on the type of user.
options.B: Store the JSON file in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Macie to identify PII data and to grant access based on the type of user.
options.C: Store the JSON file in an Amazon S3 bucket. Catalog the file schema in AWS Lake Formation. Use Lake Formation permissions to provide access to the required data based on the type of user.
options.D: Create two Amazon RDS PostgreSQL databases. Load the PII data and the non-PII data into the separate databases. Grant access to the databases based on the type of user.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 正确性分析：AWS Glue可以用于数据处理和转换，但需要额外的配置来分割文件并管理两个S3 bucket的权限。这增加了操作复杂 性。 错误原因：虽然可以实现目标，但操作开销较高，不符合“LEAST operational overhead”的要求。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 正确性分析：Amazon Macie可以识别PII数据，但它主要用于数据分类和安全监控，而不是直接管理访问权限。 错误原因：Macie无法直接实现基于用户类型的访问控制，需要额外的服务来完成权限管理。
explanations.C: Correct. 正确性分析：AWS Lake Formation可以对数据进行编目，并基于用户类型设置精细的权限控制。它直接支持数据分类和访问管理，操 作开销低。 正确原因：符合“LEAST operational overhead”的要求，同时满足数据分类和权限管理需求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 正确性分析：使用RDS可以实现数据分离和权限管理，但需要额外的数据库管理和维护。 错误原因：操作开销较高，不符合“LEAST operational overhead”的要求。

question: A company uses AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to encrypt an Amazon Redshift cluster. The company wants to configure a cross- Region snapshot of the Redshift cluster as part of disaster recovery (DR) strategy. A data engineer needs to use the AWS CLI to create the cross-Region snapshot. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create a KMS key and configure a snapshot copy grant in the source AWS Region.
options.B: In the source AWS Region, enable snapshot copying. Specify the name of the snapshot copy grant that is created in the destination AWS Region.
options.C: In the source AWS Region, enable snapshot copying. Specify the name of the snapshot copy grant that is created in the source AWS Region.
options.D: Create a KMS key and configure a snapshot copy grant in the destination AWS Region.
options.E: Convert the cluster to a Multi-AZ deployment.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 快照复制授权需要在目标区域中创建，而不是源区域。源区域的 KMS 密钥与快照复制授权无关。
explanations.B: Correct. 启用快照复制时，需要指定目标区域的快照复制授权名称，以便允许跨区域快照复制。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 快照复制授权必须在目标区域中创建，而不是源区域。
explanations.D: Correct. 目标区域需要一个 KMS 密钥和快照复制授权，以便接收和解密从源区域复制过来的快照。
explanations.E: Incorrect. Amazon Redshift 不支持 Multi-AZ 部署，这与跨区域快照复制无关。

question: A company is using Amazon S3 to build a data lake. The company needs to replicate records from multiple source databases into Apache Parquet format. Most of the source databases are hosted on Amazon RDS. However, one source database is an on-premises Microsoft SQL Server Enterprise instance. The company needs to implement a solution to replicate existing data from all source databases and all future changes to the target S3 data lake. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use one AWS Glue job to replicate existing data. Use a second AWS Glue job to replicate future changes.
options.B: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to replicate existing data. Use AWS Glue jobs to replicate future changes.
options.C: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to replicate existing data and future changes.
options.D: Use AWS Glue jobs to replicate existing data. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to replicate future changes.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：AWS Glue 是一种数据处理和转换服务，适合批处理任务，但不适合实时或增量数据复制。 未来的更改需要实时或增量同步，AWS Glue 不支持这种功能。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 部分正确：AWS DMS 可以有效地复制现有数据，但 AWS Glue 不适合处理未来的增量数据同步。 未来的更改需要实时或增量同步，AWS Glue 不支持这种功能。
explanations.C: Correct. 正确：AWS DMS 支持从多个数据源（包括 RDS 和本地数据库）复制数据到目标位置。 它可以处理现有数据的迁移，同时支持增量数据同步（CDC，Change Data Capture）。 这是最符合题目需求且成本效益最高的解决方案。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：AWS Glue 适合批处理任务，但不适合实时数据迁移。 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 是实时数据流服务，但它不直接支持数据库的增量数据同步。 这种组合不符合题目要求，且成本较高。

question: A data engineer needs to optimize the performance of a data pipeline that handles retail orders. Data about the orders is ingested daily into an Amazon S3 bucket. The data engineer runs queries once each week to extract metrics from the orders data based the order date for multiple date ranges. The data engineer needs an optimization solution that ensures the query performance will not degrade when the volume of data increases. Which solution will meet this requirement MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Partition the data based on order date. Use Amazon Athena to query the data.
options.B: Partition the data based on order date. Use Amazon Redshift to query the data.
options.C: Partition the data based on load date. Use Amazon EMR to query the data.
options.D: Partition the data based on load date. Use Amazon Aurora to query the data.

explanations.A: Correct. 正确性分析：基于订单日期进行分区可以优化查询性能，因为查询是基于订单日期范围进行的。Amazon Athena是一种无服务器查询 服务，能够直接查询存储在Amazon S3中的分区数据，且成本效益高。 结论：正确。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 正确性分析：虽然Amazon Redshift是一种高性能数据仓库，但它需要将数据从S3加载到Redshift中，这增加了额外的成本和复杂性。 对于每周一次的查询，使用Redshift并不具备成本效益。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 正确性分析：基于加载日期分区不符合查询需求，因为查询是基于订单日期范围进行的。此外，Amazon EMR通常用于处理大规模数 据集，而不是简单的查询操作，且成本较高。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 正确性分析：Amazon Aurora是关系型数据库服务，适合事务性操作而非大规模数据查询。基于加载日期分区也不符合查询需求。 结论：错误。

question: A data engineer has two datasets that contain sales information for multiple cities and states. One dataset is named reference, and the other dataset is named primary. The data engineer needs a solution to determine whether a specific set of values in the city and state columns of the primary dataset exactly match the same specific values in the reference dataset. The data engineer wants to use Data Quality Definition Language (DQDL) rules in an AWS Glue Data Quality job. Which rule will meet these requirements?

options.A: DatasetMatch "reference” “city->ref_city, state->ref_state” = 1.0
options.B: Referentiallntegrity “city,state” “reference.{ref_city,ref_state}” = 1.0
options.C: DatasetMatch “reference” “city->ref_city, state->ref_state” = 100
options.D: Referentialintegrity “city,state” "reference.{ref_city,ref_state}” = 100

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：虽然DatasetMatch可以用于比较两个数据集，但这里的语法不正确。DatasetMatch的值通常是百分比（如100%），而不是1.0。 此外，DatasetMatch更适合用于检查数据集整体的匹配程度，而不是字段级别的匹配。
explanations.B: Correct. ReferentialIntegrity “city,state” “reference.{ref_city,ref_state}” = 1.0 正确：ReferentialIntegrity规则用于检查一个数据集的字段是否在另一个数据集中存在并匹配。 语法正确，且1.0表示完全匹配（即100%）。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：虽然DatasetMatch可以用于比较两个数据集，但这里的语法仍然不正确。 DatasetMatch的值通常是百分比（如100%），但它更适合用于整体数据集的匹配，而不是字段级别的匹配。
explanations.D: Incorrect. ReferentialIntegrity “city,state” "reference.{ref_city,ref_state}” = 100 错误：ReferentialIntegrity规则的值应该是1.0（表示完全匹配），而不是100。 虽然语法接近正确，但值的单位不符合规则要求。

question: A company has an on-premises PostgreSQL database that contains customer data. The company wants to migrate the customer data to an Amazon Redshift data warehouse. The company has established a VPN connection between the on-premises database and AWS. The on-premises database is continuously updated. The company must ensure that the data in Amazon Redshift is updated as quickly as possible. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use the pg_dump utility to generate a backup of the PostgreSQL database. Use the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to upload the backup to Amazon Redshift. Set up a cron job to perform a backup. Upload the backup to Amazon Redshift every night.
options.B: Create an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) full-load task. Set Amazon Redshift as the target. Configure the task to use the change data capture (CDC) feature.
options.C: Use the pg_dump utility to generate a backup of the PostgreSQL database. Upload the backup to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use the COPY command to import the data into Amazon Redshift.
options.D: Create an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) full-load task. Set Amazon Redshift as the target. Configure the task to perform a full load of the database to Amazon Redshift every night.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 使用 pg_dump 工具生成 PostgreSQL 数据库的备份，并通过 AWS SCT 上传到 Amazon Redshift。 错误：pg_dump 和 AWS SCT 的组合适用于一次性迁移，但无法处理持续更新的数据。 错误：cron 作业每晚备份和上传无法满足“尽快更新数据”的要求。
explanations.B: Correct. 创建 AWS DMS 全量加载任务，设置 Amazon Redshift 为目标，并配置任务使用 CDC 功能。 正确：AWS DMS 支持变更数据捕获（CDC），可以持续同步源数据库的更新到目标数据库。 正确：此方法可以确保数据尽快更新到 Amazon Redshift。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 使用 pg_dump 工具生成 PostgreSQL 数据库的备份，上传到 Amazon S3，并使用 COPY 命令导入到 Amazon Redshift。 错误：pg_dump 和 COPY 命令适用于一次性迁移，但无法处理持续更新的数据。 错误：此方法无法满足“尽快更新数据”的要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 创建 AWS DMS 全量加载任务，设置 Amazon Redshift 为目标，并配置任务每晚全量加载。 错误：每晚全量加载无法满足“尽快更新数据”的要求。 错误：全量加载效率较低，且不适合处理持续更新的数据。

question: A company has several new datasets in CSV and JSON formats. A data engineer needs to make the data available to a team of data analysts who will analyze the data by using SQL queries. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST cost-effective way?

options.A: Create an Amazon RDS MySQL cluster. Use AWS Glue to transform and load the CSV and JSON files into database tables. Provide the data analysts access to the MySQL cluster.
options.B: Create an AWS Glue DataBrew project that contains the new data. Make the DataBrew project available to the data analysts.
options.C: Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use an AWS Glue crawler to catalog the S3 bucket as tables. Create an Amazon Athena workgroup that has a data usage threshold. Grant the data analysts access to the Athena workgroup.
options.D: Load the data into Super-fast, Parallel, In-memory Calculation Engine (SPICE) in Amazon QuickSight. Allow the data analysts to create analyses and dashboards in QuickSight.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 分析： 正确性：Amazon RDS MySQL可以存储数据并支持SQL查询。 问题：使用RDS MySQL需要预置计算资源，成本较高，且需要额外的管理工作（如备份、维护）。 结论：不是最具成本效益的解决方案。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 分析： 正确性：AWS Glue DataBrew可以用于数据清理和预处理。 问题：DataBrew主要用于数据准备，而不是SQL查询。数据分析师无法直接使用SQL查询DataBrew项目。 结论：不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Correct. 分析： 正确性：Amazon S3是低成本存储解决方案，AWS Glue爬虫可以自动编目数据，Amazon Athena支持直接对S3数据进行SQL查询。 优势：无需预置计算资源，按查询付费，成本效益高。 结论：符合题目要求，是最具成本效益的解决方案。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 分析： 正确性：QuickSight SPICE适用于数据可视化和仪表板创建。 问题：QuickSight主要用于数据可视化，而不是SQL查询。数据分析师无法直接使用SQL查询SPICE数据。 结论：不符合题目要求。

question: A retail company stores order information in an Amazon Aurora table named Orders. The company needs to create operational reports from the Orders table with minimal latency. The Orders table contains billions of rows, and over 100,000 transactions can occur each second. A marketing team needs to join the Orders data with an Amazon Redshift table named Campaigns in the marketing team's data warehouse. The operational Aurora database must not be affected. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

options.A: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) Serverless to replicate the Orders table to Amazon Redshift. Create a materialized view in Amazon Redshift to join with the Campaigns table.
options.B: Use the Aurora zero-ETL integration with Amazon Redshift to replicate the Orders table. Create a materialized view in Amazon Redshift to join with the Campaigns table.
options.C: Use AWS Glue to replicate the Orders table to Amazon Redshift. Create a materialized view in Amazon Redshift to join with the Campaigns table.
options.D: Use federated queries to query the Orders table directly from Aurora. Create a materialized view in Amazon Redshift to join with the Campaigns table.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 使用AWS DMS Serverless将Orders表复制到Amazon Redshift，并创建物化视图： 正确性：AWS DMS可以用于数据复制，但它需要额外的配置和管理，且可能会增加操作复杂性。 错误原因：虽然可以实现目标，但与Aurora zero-ETL相比，DMS的操作复杂性更高，不是最低操作成本的解决方案。
explanations.B: Correct. 使用Aurora zero-ETL集成Amazon Redshift，并创建物化视图： 正确性：Aurora zero-ETL是专门设计用于将Aurora数据无缝复制到Redshift的解决方案，操作成本最低。 正确原因：此选项直接利用Aurora与Redshift的集成功能，减少了额外的配置和管理工作。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 使用AWS Glue将Orders表复制到Amazon Redshift，并创建物化视图： 正确性：AWS Glue可以用于ETL任务，但它需要编写和管理ETL作业，增加了操作复杂性。 错误原因：AWS Glue的使用需要额外的开发和维护工作，不是最低操作成本的解决方案。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 使用联邦查询直接从Aurora查询Orders表，并创建物化视图： 正确性：联邦查询可以直接查询Aurora数据，但它会对Aurora数据库产生负载，影响其性能。 错误原因：此选项不符合题目要求，因为它可能会影响Aurora数据库的操作性能。

question: A company is building a new application that ingests CSV files into Amazon Redshift. The company has developed the frontend for the application. The files are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. Files are no larger than 5 MB. A data engineer is developing the extract, transform, and load (ETL) pipeline for the CSV files. The data engineer configured a Redshift cluster and an AWS Lambda function that copies the data out of the files into the Redshift cluster. Which additional steps should the data engineer perform to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the bucket to send S3 event notifications to Amazon EventBridge. Configure an EventBridge rule that matches S3 new object created events. Set the Lambda function as the target.
options.B: Configure the S3 bucket to send S3 event notifications to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure the Lambda function to process the queue.
options.C: Configure AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to stream new S3 objects to a data stream in Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Set the Lambda function as the target of the data stream.
options.D: Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule that matches S3 new object created events. Set an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as the target of the rule. Configure the Lambda function to process the queue.

explanations.A: Incorrect. S3事件到EventBridge，EventBridge规则直接触发Lambda 结论：不如B稳健（一般不作为最佳） 原因： 可行：EventBridge确实可以接收S3 Object Created类事件并触发Lambda。 但缺少队列缓冲：如果短时间大量文件到达或Lambda出现短暂错误，EventBridge虽然也有重试机制，但在“需要可控的消费速率/更 强的削峰填谷/更直观的死信处理”方面，SQS更常用。 题目强调ETL管道，对可靠投递与解耦更敏感时，增加SQS缓冲更符合工程常见要求。
explanations.B: Correct. S3事件通知到SQS，Lambda处理队列结论：正确 原因： 解耦：S3只负责投递事件到SQS；Lambda按自己的并发/批量能力消费。 可靠性：SQS提供持久化、可见性超时、重试；可配置DLQ（死信队列）处理异常消息。 削峰填谷：即使突然上传很多CSV文件，消息会堆在队列中，Lambda可以平滑消费。 与题干现状匹配：已经有Lambda负责加载Redshift，只需要补齐触发链路即可。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 用DMS把新S3对象流到Kinesis，再以Lambda为目标结论：错误 原因： AWS DMS主要用于数据库迁移/CDC（变更数据捕获）等场景，不是用来“监听S3新对象并转发事件”的标准方案。 为5MB以内的CSV文件触发加载Redshift，引入DMS与Kinesis属于明显过度设计，且不符合常见参考架构。
explanations.D: Incorrect. EventBridge匹配S3新对象事件 -> 投递到SQS -> Lambda处理队列结论：一般不选（不必要的复杂度） 原因： 架构上可行，但相对B多了一层EventBridge。 若没有跨账号路由、复杂事件模式匹配/多目标分发、统一事件总线治理等需求，S3直接投递SQS更简单直接。 题干未体现必须使用EventBridge的额外需求，因此D通常不是“应该执行的附加步骤”的最优解。

question: A company stores sensitive data in an Amazon Redshift table. The company needs to give specific users the ability to access the sensitive data. The company must not create duplication in the data. Customer support users must be able to see the last four characters of the sensitive data. Audit users must be able to see the full value of the sensitive data. No other users can have the ability to access the sensitive information. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a dynamic data masking policy to allow access based on each user role. Create IAM roles that have specific access permissions. Attach the masking policy to the column that contains sensitive data.
options.B: Enable metadata security on the Redshift cluster. Create IAM users and IAM roles for the customer support users and the audit users. Grant the IAM users and IAM roles permissions to view the metadata in the Redshift cluster.
options.C: Create a row-level security policy to allow access based on each user role. Create IAM roles that have specific access permissions. Attach the security policy to the table.
options.D: Create an AWS Glue job to redact the sensitive data and to load the data into a new Redshift table.

explanations.A: Correct. 动态数据屏蔽是一种有效的方式，可以根据用户角色动态调整数据的可见性。 通过IAM角色，可以为不同用户分配特定的访问权限。 这种方法避免了数据的重复存储，同时满足了不同用户的访问需求。 正确选项。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 元数据安全性与数据屏蔽无关，无法满足题目中对敏感数据部分可见或完全可见的需求。 此选项未提及如何处理敏感数据的部分可见性问题。 错误选项。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 行级安全性（Row-Level Security）用于控制用户对表中不同行的访问权限，而不是对列中数据的部分可见性。 此选项无法满足题目中对敏感数据部分可见或完全可见的需求。 错误选项。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 此选项会创建数据的副本，违反了题目中“不创建数据重复”的要求。 使用AWS Glue作业编辑数据并加载到新表中并不高效，也不符合动态数据屏蔽的需求。 错误选项。

question: A data engineer uses AWS Lake Formation to manage access to data that is stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. The data engineer configures an AWS Glue crawler to discover data at a specific file location in the bucket, s3://examplepath. The crawler execution fails with the following error: “The S3 location: s3://examplepath is not registered.” The data engineer needs to resolve the error. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Attach an appropriate IAM policy to the IAM role of the AWS Glue crawler to grant the crawler permission to read the S3 location.
options.B: Register the S3 location in Lake Formation to allow the crawler to access the data.
options.C: Create a new AWS Glue database. Assign the correct permissions to the database for the crawler.
options.D: Configure the S3 bucket policy to allow cross-account access.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：虽然IAM策略是AWS Glue爬虫访问S3的必要条件，但Lake Formation的权限管理是独立于IAM的。如果S3位置未在Lake Formation 中注册，爬虫仍然无法访问数据。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确：Lake Formation要求所有数据位置（如S3路径）必须先注册，才能被AWS Glue爬虫访问。这正是解决错误的关键步骤。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：AWS Glue数据库的权限与Lake Formation的S3位置注册无关。创建数据库并分配权限不会解决爬虫无法访问S3位置的问题。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：题目未提到跨账户访问的问题。即使配置了S3存储桶策略，Lake Formation仍然需要注册S3位置才能允许爬虫访问。

question: A company built a data lake and a data warehouse on AWS. The company wants to implement a data catalog to enhance the current data storage solutions. The company wants to have the capability to add business metadata and glossary information to the data catalog for every asset. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Glue Catalog. Create a user table for the business glossary. Use the AWS Glue API to change table properties to add business metadata. Create a web application to access the metadata.
options.B: Use an Apache Hive metastore. Create a user table for the business glossary. Use the ALTER TABLE command to change table properties to add business metadata. Create a web application to access the metadata.
options.C: Use Amazon DataZone. Create the business glossaries. Create metadata forms. Use the Amazon DataZone data portal to access the metadata.
options.D: Use Amazon OpenSearch Service. Create an index for the business glossary. Create a second index for the business metadata. Use the OpenSearch Service dashboard to access the metadata.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 使用 AWS Glue Catalog 分析： AWS Glue Catalog确实可以存储元数据，并且支持通过API修改表属性以添加业务元数据。 此选项需要额外的开发工作，因此操作开销较高。 结论：错误
explanations.B: Incorrect. 使用 Apache Hive metastore 分析： Apache Hive metastore可以存储元数据，并支持通过ALTER TABLE命令修改表属性以添加业务元数据。 然而，Apache Hive metastore是一个开源解决方案，需要额外的管理和维护工作，操作开销较高。 此外，它不直接支持业务术语表和元数据表单功能。 结论：错误
explanations.C: Correct. 使用 Amazon DataZone 分析： Amazon DataZone是专门设计用于数据目录和数据治理的服务，支持创建业务术语表和元数据表单。 它提供了一个数据门户，可以直接访问元数据，无需额外开发工作。 此选项完全满足题目要求，并且操作开销最低。 结论：正确
explanations.D: Incorrect. 使用 Amazon OpenSearch Service 分析： Amazon OpenSearch Service可以存储和索引数据，但它主要用于搜索和分析，而不是数据目录功能。 需要额外开发工作来创建索引和仪表板以访问元数据，操作开销较高。 此选项不适合实现数据目录功能。 结论：错误

question: A data engineer is using an AWS Glue ETL job to remove outdated customer records from a table that contains customer account information. The data engineer is using the following SQL command to remove customers that exist in a table named monthly_accounts_update table from the customer accounts table: MERGE INTO accounts t USING monthly_accounts_update s ON t.customer = s.customer - WHEN MATCHED - THEN DELETE - What will happen when the data engineer runs the SQL command?

options.A: All customer records that exist in both the customer accounts table and the monthly_accounts_update table will be deleted from the accounts table.
options.B: Only customer records that are present in both tables will be retained in the customer accounts table.
options.C: The monthly_accounts_update table will be deleted.
options.D: No records will be deleted because the command syntax is not valid in AWS Glue.

explanations.A: Correct. 这是正确的答案。MERGE语句的逻辑是基于匹配条件（ON t.customer = s.customer），当匹配时执行DELETE操作。因 此，所有同时存在于两个表中的记录会被删除。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 这是错误的答案。MERGE语句的逻 辑是删除匹配的记录，而不是保留它们。因此，这个选项与题目描述的SQL命令不符。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 这是错误的答案。MERGE语句只会操作目标表（accounts），不会删除源表 （monthly_accounts_update）。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 这是错误的答案。虽然AWS Glue支持SQL操作，但 MERGE语句是有效的，且题目中的语法是正确的。因此，这个选项不成立。

question: A company receives marketing campaign data from a vendor. The company ingests the data into an Amazon S3 bucket every 40 to 60 minutes. The data is in CSV format. File sizes are between 100 KB and 300 KB. A data engineer needs to set-up an extract, transform, and load (ETL) pipeline to upload the content of each file to Amazon Redshift. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function that connects to Amazon Redshift and runs a COPY command. Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke the Lambda function based on an Amazon S3 upload trigger.
options.B: Create an Amazon Data Firehose stream. Configure the stream to use an AWS Lambda function as a source to pull data from the S3 bucket. Set Amazon Redshift as the destination.
options.C: Use Amazon Redshift Spectrum to query the S3 bucket. Configure an AWS Glue Crawler for the S3 bucket to update metadata in an AWS Glue Data Catalog.
options.D: Creates an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) task. Specify an appropriate data schema to migrate. Specify the appropriate type of migration to use.

explanations.A: Correct. 分析： Lambda函数可以轻松连接到Amazon Redshift并运行COPY命令，COPY命令是将数据从S3加载到Redshift的高效方法。 EventBridge可以基于S3上传事件触发Lambda函数，自动化程度高，减少了人工干预。 操作开销低，因为Lambda是无服务器的，且COPY命令直接处理CSV文件。 此选项符合题目要求，正确。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 分析： Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose通常用于实时数据流处理，而题目中的数据每40到60分钟上传一次，非实时场景。 配置Firehose流和Lambda函数作为源增加了复杂性，操作开销较高。 此选项不符合“最少操作开销”的要求，错误。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 分析： Redshift Spectrum用于直接查询S3中的数据，而题目要求将数据加载到Redshift中，目的不同。 配置Glue Crawler和Data Catalog增加了额外的步骤和复杂性，操作开销较高。 此选项不符合题目要求，错误。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 分析： AWS DMS主要用于数据库之间的迁移，而题目中的数据是CSV文件，DMS不适合处理这种场景。 需要定义数据架构和迁移类型，增加了复杂性和操作开销。 此选项不符合题目要求，错误。

question: A company wants to build a dimension table in an Amazon S3 bucket. The bucket contains historical data that includes 10 million records. The historical data is 1 TB in size. A data engineer needs a solution to update changes for up to 10,000 records in the base table every day. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LOWEST runtime?

options.A: Develop an Apache Spark job in Amazon EMR to read the historical data and the new changes into two Spark DataFrames. Use the Spark update method to update the base table.
options.B: Develop an AWS Glue Python job to read the historical data and new changes into two Pandas DataFrames. Use the Pandas update method to update the base table.
options.C: Develop an AWS Glue Apache Spark job to read the historical data and new changes into two Spark DataFrames. Use the Spark update method to update the base table.
options.D: Develop an Amazon EMR job to read new changes into Apache Spark DataFrames. Use the Apache Hudi framework to create the base table in Amazon S3. Use the Spark update method to update the base table.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 正确性分析：虽然Amazon EMR可以高效处理大规模数据，但直接使用Spark更新方法处理1TB的历史数据和每日10,000条增量更新会 导致性能瓶颈，因为Spark本身不擅长处理增量更新。 结论：此选项效率较低，不是最佳选择。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 正确性分析：Pandas适合处理小规模数据，但对于1TB的历史数据和每日增量更新，Pandas的内存限制和性能不足会导致运行时间过 长。 结论：此选项不适合大规模数据处理。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 正确性分析：AWS Glue可以使用Spark处理数据，但它的主要优势在于ETL任务，而不是高效处理增量更新。直接使用Spark更新方法 处理1TB数据仍然会导致性能问题。 结论：此选项效率较低，不是最佳选择。
explanations.D: Correct. 正确性分析：Apache Hudi是专门设计用于高效处理增量更新的框架。它支持在Amazon S3上创建表，并通过增量更新方法显著降低运 行时间。结合Amazon EMR的高性能计算能力，此选项是最佳解决方案。 结论：此选项效率最高，符合题目要求。

question: A data engineer develops an AWS Glue Apache Spark ETL job to perform transformations on a dataset. When the data engineer runs the job, the job returns an error that reads, “No space left on device.” The data engineer needs to identify the source of the error and provide a solution. Which combinations of steps will meet this requirement MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)

options.A: Scale out the workers vertically to address data skewness.
options.B: Use the Spark UI and AWS Glue metrics to monitor data skew in the Spark executors.
options.C: Scale out the number of workers horizontally to address data skewness.
options.D: Enable the --write-shuffie-files-to-s3 job parameter. Use the salting technique.
options.E: Use error logs in Amazon CloudWatch to monitor data skew.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：垂直扩展（增加单个worker的资源）并不能有效解决数据倾斜问题，因为数据倾斜通常是由于某些分区的数据量过大，而不 是单个worker资源不足。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确：Spark UI和AWS Glue的指标可以帮助识别数据倾斜问题，提供详细的执行器级别的性能数据。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：水平扩展worker数量虽然可以增加计算能力，但并不能直接解决数据倾斜问题，因为数据倾斜是分区不均匀的问题，而不是 worker数量不足的问题。
explanations.D: Correct. 正确：启用--write-shuffle-files-to-s3参数可以将中间数据写入S3，避免磁盘空间不足的问题。Salting技术可以通过添加随机值来均匀分 布数据，从而解决数据倾斜问题。
explanations.E: Incorrect. 错误：虽然CloudWatch可以监控错误日志，但它无法提供详细的Spark执行器级别的数据倾斜信息，因此不适合用于解决数据倾斜问 题。

question: A company has a data pipeline that uses an Amazon RDS instance, AWS Glue jobs, and an Amazon S3 bucket. The RDS instance and AWS Glue jobs run in a private subnet of a VPC and in the same security group. A user made a change to the security group that prevents the AWS Glue jobs from connecting to the RDS instance. After the change, the security group contains a single rule that allows inbound SSH traffic from a specific IP address. The company must resolve the connectivity issue. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Add an inbound rule that allows all TCP traffic on all TCP ports. Set the security group as the source.
options.B: Add an inbound rule that allows all TCP traffic on all UDP ports. Set the private IP address of the RDS instance as the source.
options.C: Add an inbound rule that allows all TCP traffic on all TCP ports. Set the DNS name of the RDS instance as the source.
options.D: Replace the source of the existing SSH rule with the private IP address of the RDS instance. Create an outbound rule with the same source, destination, and protocol as the inbound SSH rule.

explanations.A: Correct. 正确性分析：此选项允许安全组内的资源之间进行通信，因为安全组作为来源可以确保 AWS Glue 和 RDS 实例之间的连接。允许所有 TCP 流量是解决问题的直接方法。 优点：简单直接，解决了 AWS Glue 无法连接到 RDS 的问题。 缺点：安全性较低，因为允许所有 TCP 流量可能会带来潜在的安全风险。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 正确性分析：此选项错误，因为 RDS 和 AWS Glue 的通信使用的是 TCP 协议，而不是 UDP 协议。 优点：无。 缺点：无法解决问题，因为 UDP 端口规则与实际需求不匹配。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 正确性分析：此选项错误，因为安全组规则中无法直接使用 DNS 名称作为来源。安全组规则需要使用 IP 地址或安全组作为来源。 优点：无。 缺点：技术上不可行，无法解决问题。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 正确性分析：此选项错误，因为 SSH 规则与 AWS Glue 和 RDS 的通信无关。更改 SSH 规则不会解决问题。 优点：无。 缺点：无法解决问题，且可能影响现有的 SSH 连接。

question: A company builds a new data pipeline to process data for business intelligence reports. Users have noticed that data is missing from the reports. A data engineer needs to add a data quality check for columns that contain null values and for referential integrity at a stage before the data is added to storage. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler to create a Data Quality and Insights report.
options.B: Use AWS Glue ETL jobs to perform a data quality evaluation transform on the data. Use an IsComplete rule on the requested columns. Use a ReferentialItegrity rule for each join.
options.C: Use AWS Glue ETL jobs to perform a SQL transform on the data to determine whether requested column contain null values. Use a second SQL transform to check referential integrity.
options.D: Use Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler and a custom Python transform to create custom rules to check for null values and referential integrity.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误原因：Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler主要用于数据准备和可视化分析，而不是专门设计用于数据质量检查和规则验证。它无 法直接满足对空值和引用完整性检查的需求。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确原因：AWS Glue ETL支持内置的“Data Quality Evaluation Transform”，可以直接使用IsComplete规则检查空值，并使用 ReferentialIntegrity规则验证引用完整性。这种方法是专门设计用于数据质量检查的，且操作开销较低。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误原因：虽然可以使用SQL转换来检查空值和引用完整性，但需要手动编写SQL代码，增加了操作复杂性和维护成本，不符合“最 少操作开销”的要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误原因：使用自定义Python转换需要额外的开发工作和维护成本，操作开销较高，不符合题目要求。

question: A company is setting up a data pipeline in AWS. The pipeline extracts client data from Amazon S3 buckets, performs quality checks, and transforms the data. The pipeline stores the processed data in a relational database. The company will use the processed data for future queries. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use AWS Glue ETL to extract the data from the S3 buckets and perform the transformations. Use AWS Glue Data Quality to enforce suggested quality rules. Load the data and the quality check results into an Amazon RDS for MySQL instance.
options.B: Use AWS Glue Studio to extract the data from the S3 buckets. Use AWS Glue DataBrew to perform the transformations and quality checks. Load the processed data into an Amazon RDS for MySQL instance. Load the quality check results into a new S3 bucket.
options.C: Use AWS Glue ETL to extract the data from the S3 buckets and perform the transformations. Use AWS Glue DataBrew to perform quality checks. Load the processed data and the quality check results into a new S3 bucket.
options.D: Use AWS Glue Studio to extract the data from the S3 buckets. Use AWS Glue DataBrew to perform the transformations and quality checks. Load the processed data and quality check results into an Amazon RDS for MySQL instance.

explanations.A: Correct. 正确性：AWS Glue ETL是专门设计用于处理复杂的ETL任务，能够高效地提取和转换数据。 质量检查：AWS Glue Data Quality是专门用于数据质量检查的工具，能够强制执行质量规则。 存储：Amazon RDS for MySQL是一个托管的关系数据库服务，适合存储结构化数据并支持未来查询。 成本效益：此方案使用了AWS Glue的核心功能和Amazon RDS，避免了额外的存储成本，符合题目要求的“最具成本效益”。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 正确性：AWS Glue Studio可以用于数据提取，但它更适合可视化工作流设计，而不是复杂的ETL任务。 质量检查：AWS Glue DataBrew可以执行质量检查，但它更适合数据准备，而不是强制执行质量规则。 存储：将质量检查结果存储到一个新的S3桶中增加了额外的存储成本，不符合“最具成本效益”的要求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 正确性：AWS Glue ETL适合复杂的ETL任务，但AWS Glue DataBrew更适合数据准备，而不是强制执行质量规则。 存储：将数据和质量检查结果存储到S3桶中不符合题目要求，因为题目明确要求将数据存储到关系数据库中以支持未来查询。 成本效益：使用S3存储数据可能会降低查询效率，增加后续处理成本。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 正确性：AWS Glue Studio适合可视化工作流设计，但不适合复杂的ETL任务。 质量检查：AWS Glue DataBrew更适合数据准备，而不是强制执行质量规则。 存储：将数据和质量检查结果加载到Amazon RDS符合题目要求，但前面的工具选择不够优化。 成本效益：此方案的工具选择可能增加开发复杂性和成本，不是最具成本效益的方案。

question: A company uses Amazon Redshift as a data warehouse solution. One of the datasets that the company stores in Amazon Redshift contains data for a vendor. Recently, the vendor asked the company to transfer the vendor’s data into the vendor’s Amazon S3 bucket once each week. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to connect to the Redshift data warehouse. Configure the Lambda function to use the Redshift COPY command to copy the required data to the vendor’s S3 bucket on a schedule.
options.B: Create an AWS Glue job to connect to the Redshift data warehouse. Configure the AWS Glue job to use the Redshift UNLOAD command to load the required data to the vendor’s S3 bucket on a schedule.
options.C: Use the Amazon Redshift data sharing feature. Set the vendor’s S3 bucket as the destination. Configure the source to be as a custom SQL query that selects the required data.
options.D: Configure Amazon Redshift Spectrum to use the vendor’s S3 bucket a destination, Enable data querying in both directions.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：Redshift COPY命令用于从S3加载数据到Redshift，而不是将数据从Redshift导出到S3。 Lambda可以定时触发，但COPY命令不适合此场景。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确：UNLOAD命令可以将Redshift中的数据导出到S3。 AWS Glue支持定时任务，可以通过UNLOAD命令将数据导出到指定的S3 bucket。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：Redshift数据共享功能用于在多个Redshift集群之间共享数据，而不是直接导出数据到S3。 此选项与题目要求不符。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：Redshift Spectrum用于查询存储在S3中的数据，而不是将Redshift中的数据导出到S3。 双向数据查询与题目要求无关。

question: A company uses an Amazon Redshift cluster as a data warehouse that is shared across two departments. To comply with a security policy, each department must have unique access permissions. Department A must have access to tables and views for Department A. Department B must have access to tables and views for Department B. The company often runs SQL queries that use objects from both departments in one query. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Group tables and views for each department into dedicated schemas. Manage permissions at the schema level.
options.B: Group tables and views for each department into dedicated databases. Manage permissions at the database level.
options.C: Update the names of the tables and views to follow a naming convention that contains the department names. Manage permissions based on the new naming convention.
options.D: Create an IAM user group for each department. Use identity-based IAM policies to grant table and view permissions based on the IAM user group.

explanations.A: Correct. 将表和视图分组到专用的 schema 中，并在 schema 级别管理权限是 Amazon Redshift 中推荐的最佳实践。通过 schema，可以 轻松地对不同部门的数据进行逻辑分组，并且可以直接在 schema 级别设置权限，从而减少操作开销。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Amazon Redshift 是一个单数据库系统，通常不支持多个数据库的分区管理。将数据分组到多个数据库会增加复杂性，并且不 符合 Redshift 的设计模式。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 基于命名约定管理权限是一种低效且容易出错的方法。命名约定无法提供真正的权限隔离，且需要额外的操作来解析和管理 权限。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Amazon Redshift 的权限管理主要基于数据库级别的角色和权限，而不是 IAM 策略。IAM 策略无法直接管理 Redshift 表和视图 的权限。

question: A company wants to ingest streaming data into an Amazon Redshift data warehouse from an Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) cluster. A data engineer needs to develop a solution that provides low data access time and that optimizes storage costs. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an external schema that maps to the MSK cluster. Create a materialized view that references the external schema to consume the streaming data from the MSK topic.
options.B: Develop an AWS Glue streaming extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to process the incoming data from Amazon MSK. Load the data into Amazon S3. Use Amazon Redshift Spectrum to read the data from Amazon S3.
options.C: Create an external schema that maps to the streaming data source. Create a new Amazon Redshift table that references the external schema.
options.D: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Ingest the data from Amazon MSK. Create an event-driven AWS Lambda function to load the data from the S3 bucket to a new Amazon Redshift table.

explanations.A: Correct. 正确性分析：此选项利用Amazon Redshift的外部模式和物化视图功能直接从MSK消费数据。这种方法可以减少数据访问时间，因为 数据直接从流中消费，而不需要中间存储。物化视图可以优化查询性能。 存储成本：由于数据直接从流中消费，没有额外的存储成本。 操作复杂度：外部模式和物化视图的设置相对简单，操作复杂度较低。 结论：此选项是一个合理的解决方案，符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 开发一个 AWS Glue 流式 ETL 作业，以处理来自 Amazon MSK 的输入数据。将数据加载到 Amazon S3。使用 Amazon Redshift Spectrum 从 Amazon S3 读取数据。 正确性分析：此选项使用AWS Glue进行流式ETL处理，将数据存储到Amazon S3，并通过Redshift Spectrum查询数据。这种方法适合处 理复杂的ETL需求，但增加了数据访问时间，因为数据需要先存储到S3。 存储成本：S3存储成本较低，但增加了额外的存储开销。 操作复杂度：需要开发和维护Glue作业，操作复杂度较高。 结论：此选项不符合“低数据访问时间”和“最低操作复杂度”的要求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 正确性分析：此选项提到创建外部模式，但没有提到如何处理流数据的消费问题。直接创建Redshift表引用外部模式并不能有效处理 流数据。 存储成本：没有明确提到存储优化策略。 操作复杂度：缺乏具体的流数据处理逻辑，操作复杂度较低，但功能不完整。 结论：此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 正确性分析：此选项使用S3作为中间存储，并通过Lambda函数将数据加载到Redshift。这种方法增加了数据访问时间，因为数据需要 先存储到S3。 存储成本：S3存储成本较低，但增加了额外的存储开销。 操作复杂度：需要开发和维护Lambda函数，操作复杂度较高。 结论：此选项不符合“低数据访问时间”和“最低操作复杂度”的要求。

question: A sales company uses AWS Glue ETL to collect, process, and ingest data into an Amazon S3 bucket. The AWS Glue pipeline creates a new file in the S3 bucket every hour. File sizes vary from 200 KB to 300 KB. The company wants to build a sales prediction model by using data from the previous 5 years. The historic data includes 44,000 files. The company builds a second AWS Glue ETL pipeline by using the smallest worker type. The second pipeline retrieves the historic files from the S3 bucket and processes the files for downstream analysis. The company notices significant performance issues with the second ETL pipeline. The company needs to improve the performance of the second pipeline. Which solution will meet this requirement MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use a larger worker type.
options.B: Increase the number of workers in the AWS Glue ETL jobs.
options.C: Use the AWS Glue DynamicFrame grouping option.
options.D: Enable AWS Glue auto scaling.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 分析：更大的worker类型可以提供更高的计算能力，但并不能解决小文件处理的性能问题。小文件处理的瓶颈通常在于I/O操作和文 件合并，而不是计算能力。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 分析：增加worker数量可以提高并行处理能力，但仍然无法解决小文件处理的核心问题。大量小文件会导致过多的I/O操作，增加 worker数量可能会导致资源浪费。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.C: Correct. 分析：DynamicFrame分组选项可以将小文件合并为更大的分组，从而减少I/O操作并提高处理效率。这是解决小文件性能问题的最佳 实践。 结论：此选项正确。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 分析：自动扩展可以动态调整资源以满足作业需求，但它无法直接解决小文件处理的性能问题。小文件问题需要通过数据分组或合 并来优化，而不是依赖自动扩展。 结论：此选项错误。

question: A company wants to combine data from multiple software as a service (SaaS) applications for analysis. A data engineering team needs to use Amazon QuickSight to perform the analysis and build dashboards. A data engineer needs to extract the data from the SaaS applications and make the data available for QuickSight queries. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: Create AWS Lambda functions that call the required APIs to extract the data from the applications. Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use AWS Glue to catalog the data in the S3 bucket. Create a data source and a dataset in QuickSight.
options.B: Use AWS Lambda functions as Amazon Athena data source connectors to run federated queries against the SaaS applications. Create an Athena data source and a dataset in QuickSight.
options.C: Use Amazon AppFlow to create a flow for each SaaS application. Set an Amazon S3 bucket as the destination. Schedule the flows to extract the data to the bucket. Use AWS Glue to catalog the data in the S3 bucket. Create a data source and a dataset in QuickSight.
options.D: Export data the from the SaaS applications as Microsoft Excel files. Create a data source and a dataset in QuickSight by uploading the Excel files.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 正确性分析：使用Lambda函数调用API提取数据是可行的，但需要手动编写和维护代码，增加了操作复杂性。 错误原因：虽然可以实现目标，但操作效率较低，且需要额外的开发和维护工作。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 正确性分析：使用Athena进行联邦查询是可行的，但需要配置Lambda作为Athena数据源连接器，增加了复杂性。 错误原因：这种方法对操作效率的提升有限，且对SaaS应用的API支持可能不够全面。
explanations.C: Correct. 正确性分析：Amazon AppFlow是专门设计用于从SaaS应用程序提取数据的服务，支持自动化和高效的数据流管理。 正确原因：此选项操作效率最高，且无需额外开发工作，完全符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 正确性分析：手动导出Excel文件并上传到QuickSight是可行的，但完全依赖人工操作。 错误原因：操作效率极低，无法满足自动化需求。

question: A company runs multiple applications on AWS. The company configured each application to output logs. The company wants to query and visualize the application logs in near real time. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the applications to output logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs log groups. Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Create an AWS Lambda function that runs on a schedule to export the required log groups to the S3 bucket. Use Amazon Athena to query the log data in the S3 bucket.
options.B: Create an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain. Configure the applications to output logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs log groups. Create an OpenSearch Service subscription filter for each log group to stream the data to OpenSearch. Create the required queries and dashboards in OpenSearch Service to analyze and visualize the data.
options.C: Configure the applications to output logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs log groups. Use CloudWatch log anomaly detection to query and visualize the log data.
options.D: Update the application code to send the log data to Amazon QuickSight by using Super-fast, Parallel, In-memory Calculation Engine (SPICE). Create the required analyses and dashboards in QuickSight.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 将日志输出到CloudWatch Logs，使用Lambda定期导出到S3，并用Athena查询 正确性分析：此方案可以实现日志查询，但由于Lambda是定期运行的，无法满足“近实时”查询的要求。 错误原因：Athena适合查询静态数据，而不是实时数据。此方案不符合题目要求的“近实时”需求。
explanations.B: Correct. 使用OpenSearch Service订阅过滤器将日志流式传输到OpenSearch 正确性分析：OpenSearch Service支持实时数据流式传输和查询，并提供强大的可视化功能（如仪表板）。 正确原因：此方案完全符合题目要求，可以实现近实时的日志查询和可视化。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 使用CloudWatch日志异常检测查询和可视化日志数据 正确性分析：CloudWatch日志异常检测主要用于检测日志中的异常模式，而不是用于全面的日志查询和可视化。 错误原因：此方案不适合实现复杂的查询和可视化需求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 更新应用代码，将日志发送到QuickSight 正确性分析：QuickSight是一个商业智能工具，适合分析结构化数据，但不适合直接处理日志数据。 错误原因：此方案需要修改应用代码，且QuickSight不支持实时日志查询和可视化。

question: An ecommerce company processes millions of orders each day. The company uses AWS Glue ETL to collect data from multiple sources, clean the data, and store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket in CSV format by using the S3 Standard storage class. The company uses the stored data to conduct daily analysis. The company wants to optimize costs for data storage and retrieval. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Transition the data to Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.
options.B: Transition the data from Amazon S3 to an Amazon Aurora cluster.
options.C: Configure AWS Glue ETL to transform the incoming data to Apache Parquet format.
options.D: Configure AWS Glue ETL to use Amazon EMR to process incoming data in parallel.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval适用于长期存储和归档数据，但不适合频繁访问的数据（如每日分析）。将数据转移到 Glacier会导致检索时间增加，不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：Amazon Aurora是关系型数据库服务，适合事务处理或结构化查询，但不适合存储大量非结构化数据（如CSV文件）。此外， Aurora的成本通常高于S3，不符合优化存储成本的要求。
explanations.C: Correct. 正确：Apache Parquet是一种列式存储格式，能够显著减少存储空间并提高查询性能。将数据从CSV转换为Parquet格式可以优化存储 成本，同时提高数据分析效率。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：Amazon EMR用于大规模数据处理和分析，但题目重点是优化存储成本，而不是处理性能。此选项未解决存储成本问题。

question: A data engineer is optimizing query performance in Amazon Athena notebooks that use Apache Spark to analyze large datasets that are stored in Amazon S3. The data is partitioned. An AWS Glue crawler updates the partitions. The data engineer wants to minimize the amount of data that is scanned to improve efficiency of Athena queries. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Apply partition filters in the queries.
options.B: Increase the frequency of AWS Glue crawler invocations to update the data catalog more often.
options.C: Organize the data that is in Amazon S3 by using a nested directory structure.
options.D: Configure Spark to use in-memory caching for frequently accessed data.

explanations.A: Correct. 分区过滤器可以显著减少扫描的数据量，从而提高查询效率。这是优化分区数据查询的最佳实践。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 虽然频繁更新数据目录可以确保数据的最新性，但它不会直接减少查询扫描的数据量。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 虽然嵌套目录结构可以帮助组织数据，但仅靠目录结构不会自动减少扫描的数据量，分区过滤器才是关键。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 内存缓存可以提高数据访问速度，但它与减少扫描的数据量无关。

question: A company manages an Amazon Redshift data warehouse. The data warehouse is in a public subnet inside a custom VPC. A security group allows only traffic from within itself. An ACL is open to all traffic. The company wants to generate several visualizations in Amazon QuickSight for an upcoming sales event. The company will run QuickSight Enterprise edition in a second AWS account inside a public subnet within a second custom VPC. The new public subnet has a security group that allows outbound traffic to the existing Redshift cluster. A data engineer needs to establish connections between Amazon Redshift and QuickSight. QuickSight must refresh dashboards by querying the Redshift cluster. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the Redshift security group to allow inbound traffic on the Redshift port from the QuickSight security group.
options.B: Assign Elastic IP addresses to the QuickSight visualizations. Configure the QuickSight security group to allow inbound traffic on the Redshift port from the Elastic IP addresses.
options.C: Confirm that the CIDR ranges of the Redshift VPC and the QuickSight VPC are the same. If CIDR ranges are different, reconfigure one CIDR range to match the other. Establish network peering between the VPCs.
options.D: Create a QuickSight gateway endpoint in the Redshift VPC. Attach an endpoint policy to the gateway endpoint to ensure only specific QuickSight accounts can use the endpoint.

explanations.A: Correct. 正确：此选项直接解决了问题，通过修改Redshift的安全组规则，允许来自QuickSight安全组的流量访问Redshift的端口。QuickSight可 以通过安全组规则访问Redshift。 安全组是VPC内的主要访问控制机制，允许基于源安全组的流量规则是常见的做法。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：QuickSight本身不支持直接分配Elastic IP地址。Elastic IP地址通常用于EC2实例，而不是QuickSight服务。 此外，使用Elastic IP地址进行访问控制并不符合AWS最佳实践，因为它增加了管理复杂性。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：虽然VPC对等连接可以解决跨VPC通信问题，但题目中并未提到需要重新配置CIDR范围。此外，VPC对等连接的设置复杂度较 高，且题目中没有明确要求使用这种方法。 QuickSight可以通过安全组规则直接访问Redshift，无需额外的VPC对等连接。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：QuickSight不支持通过网关终端节点直接连接到Redshift。网关终端节点通常用于访问AWS服务（如S3或DynamoDB），而不是用 于跨账户或跨VPC的服务连接。 此选项与题目要求不符。

question: A data engineer is building a data pipeline. A large data file is uploaded to an Amazon S3 bucket once each day at unpredictable times. An AWS Glue workflow uses hundreds of workers to process the file and load the data into Amazon Redshift. The company wants to process the file as quickly as possible. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an on-demand AWS Glue trigger to start the workflow. Create an AWS Lambda function that runs every 15 minutes to check the S3 bucket for the daily file. Configure the function to start the AWS Glue workflow if the file is present.
options.B: Create an event-based AWS Glue trigger to start the workflow. Configure Amazon S3 to log events to AWS CloudTrail. Create a rule in Amazon EventBridge to forward PutObject events to the AWS Glue trigger.
options.C: Create a scheduled AWS Glue trigger to start the workflow. Create a cron job that runs the AWS Glue job every 15 minutes. Set up the AWS Glue job to check the S3 bucket for the daily file. Configure the job to stop if the file is not present.
options.D: Create an on-demand AWS Glue trigger to start the workflow. Create an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) migration task. Set the DMS source as the S3 bucket. Set the target endpoint as the AWS Glue workflow.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 分析： 正确性：此方法可以实现目标，但效率较低，因为Lambda函数每15分钟轮询一次S3，可能会导致延迟。 错误原因：轮询机制不够高效，无法满足“尽快处理文件”的要求。
explanations.B: Correct. 分析： 正确性：此方法利用了事件驱动机制，能够在文件上传到S3时立即触发AWS Glue工作流。 优势：事件驱动机制效率高，能够满足“尽快处理文件”的要求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 分析： 正确性：此方法可以实现目标，但效率较低，因为计划触发器每15分钟运行一次，可能会导致延迟。 错误原因：计划触发器不够高效，无法满足“尽快处理文件”的要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 分析： 正确性：AWS DMS主要用于数据库迁移，而不是处理S3文件上传事件。 错误原因：此方法不适合当前场景，且AWS DMS无法直接触发AWS Glue工作流。

question: A data engineer needs to run a data transformation job whenever a user adds a file to an Amazon S3 bucket. The job will run for less than 1 minute. The job must send the output through an email message to the data engineer. The data engineer expects users to add one file every hour of the day. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: Create a small Amazon EC2 instance that polls the S3 bucket for new files. Run transformation code on a schedule to generate the output. Use operating system commands to send email messages.
options.B: Run an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) task to poll the S3 bucket for new files. Run transformation code on a schedule to generate the output. Use operating system commands to send email messages.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function to transform the data. Use Amazon S3 Event Notifications to invoke the Lambda function when a new object is created. Publish the output to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe the data engineer’s email account to the topic.
options.D: Deploy an Amazon EMR cluster. Use EMR File System (EMRFS) to access the files in the S3 bucket. Run transformation code on a schedule to generate the output to a second S3 bucket. Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure Amazon S3 Event Notifications to notify the topic when a new object is created.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Create a small Amazon EC2 instance that polls the S3 bucket for new files... 分析：此选项需要手动轮询S3存储桶，增加了复杂性和运营成本。EC2实例需要持续运行，浪费资源，不符合“最具操作效率”的要 求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Run an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) task to poll the S3 bucket... 分析：虽然ECS任务比EC2实例更灵活，但仍然需要轮询S3存储桶，增加了不必要的复杂性和成本。操作效率不高。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Correct. Create an AWS Lambda function to transform the data... 分析：此选项使用S3事件通知自动触发Lambda函数，无需轮询，完全无服务器架构。Lambda函数运行时间短，非常适合此场景。 SNS可以直接发送邮件，满足需求。 结论：正确。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Deploy an Amazon EMR cluster... 分析：EMR集群适用于大规模数据处理，而此场景仅需处理单个文件，EMR过于复杂且成本高。虽然使用了SNS，但整体架构不符 合“最具操作效率”的要求。 结论：错误。

question: A company uses Amazon S3 and AWS Glue Data Catalog to manage a data lake that contains contact information for customers. The company uses PySpark and AWS Glue jobs with a DynamicFrame to run a workflow that processes data within the data lake. A data engineer notices that the workflow is generating errors as a result of how customer postal codes are stored in the data lake. Some postal codes include unnecessary numbers or invalid characters. The data engineer needs a solution to address the errors and correct the postal codes in the data lake.

options.A: Create a schema definition for PySpark that matches the format the processing workflow requires for postal codes. Pass the schema to the DynamicFrame during processing.
options.B: Use AWS Glue workflow properties to allow job state sharing. Configure the AWS Glue jobs to read values from the postal code column by using the properties from a previously successful run of the jobs.
options.C: Configure the column.push_down_predicate setting and the catalogPartitionPredicate settings for the postal code column in the DynamicFrame.
options.D: Set the DynamicFrame additional_options parameter ‘useS3ListImplementation’ to True.

explanations.A: Correct. 正确：通过定义一个符合工作流要求的模式，可以确保数据处理时邮政编码的格式正确。这是解决数据质量问题的标准方法。 DynamicFrame支持模式定义，能够帮助清理和验证数据格式。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 错误：AWS Glue工作流属性用于作业状态共享，与数据清理或格式校验无关。 此选项未解决邮政编码格式问题，且依赖之前成功运行的作业属性并不适合当前场景。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：column.push_down_predicate和catalogPartitionPredicate用于过滤数据或分区选择，与数据清理或格式校验无关。 此选项未解决邮政编码中无效字符或多余数字的问题。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：useS3ListImplementation参数用于优化S3文件列表操作，与数据清理或格式校验无关。 此选项未解决邮政编码格式问题。

question: A data engineer is troubleshooting an AWS Glue workflow that occasionally fails. The engineer determines that the failures are a result of data quality issues. A business reporting team needs to receive an email notification any time the workflow fails in the future. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) FIFO topic. Subscribe the team’s email account to the SNS topic. Create an AWS Lambda function that initiates when the AWS Glue job state changes to FAILED. Set the SNS topic as the target.
options.B: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) standard topic. Subscribe the team’s email account to the SNS topic. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that triggers when the AWS Glue job state changes to FAILED. Set the SNS topic as the target.
options.C: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Subscribe the team’s email account to the SQS queue. Create an AWS Config rule that triggers when the AWS Glue job state changes to FAILED. Set the SQS queue as the target.
options.D: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue. Subscribe the team’s email account to the SQS queue. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that triggers when the AWS Glue job state changes to FAILESet the SQS queue as the target.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) FIFO topic... 分析： SNS FIFO主题主要用于严格的消息顺序和去重场景，而本题没有提到需要FIFO功能。 虽然可以通过Lambda函数监控Glue作业状态，但EventBridge是更直接的解决方案。 此选项复杂度较高且不符合最佳实践。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Correct. Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) standard topic... 分析： SNS标准主题适合发送通知，支持电子邮件订阅。 EventBridge可以直接监控AWS Glue作业状态并触发通知，是最佳实践。 此选项符合题目要求，解决方案简单且高效。 结论：正确。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue... 分析： SQS FIFO队列主要用于消息顺序和去重场景，不适合直接发送电子邮件通知。 AWS Config规则不适用于Glue作业状态监控。 此选项不符合题目要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue... 分析： SQS标准队列用于消息队列场景，不适合直接发送电子邮件通知。 虽然EventBridge可以监控Glue作业状态，但SQS不是最佳目标。 此选项不符合题目要求。 结论：错误。

question: A company uses AWS Glue jobs to implement several data pipelines. The pipelines are critical to the company. The company needs to implement a monitoring mechanism that will alert stakeholders if the pipelines fail. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to match AWS Glue job failure events. Configure the rule to target an AWS Lambda function to process events. Configure the function to send notifications to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.
options.B: Configure an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group for the AWS Glue jobs. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to match new log creation events in the log group. Configure the rule to target an AWS Lambda function that reads the logs and sends notifications to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic if AWS Glue job failure logs are present.
options.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to match AWS Glue job failure events. Define an Amazon CloudWatch metric based on the EventBridge rule. Set up a CloudWatch alarm based on the metric to send notifications to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.
options.D: Configure an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group for the AWS Glue jobs. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to match new log creation events in the log group. Configure the rule to send notifications to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 分析：此选项通过EventBridge规则捕获Glue作业失败事件，并使用Lambda函数处理事件后发送SNS通知。虽然可以实现目标，但引入 了Lambda函数，增加了额外的操作复杂性，不符合“LEAST operational overhead”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 分析：此选项通过CloudWatch Logs和EventBridge规则捕获日志事件，并使用Lambda函数解析日志以检测失败情况。与选项A类似， Lambda函数的引入增加了操作复杂性，不符合“LEAST operational overhead”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Correct. 分析：此选项直接使用EventBridge规则捕获Glue作业失败事件，并通过CloudWatch指标和警报发送SNS通知。整个流程无需额外的 Lambda函数或复杂的日志解析，完全符合“LEAST operational overhead”的要求。 结论：正确。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 分析：此选项通过CloudWatch Logs和EventBridge规则捕获日志事件，并直接发送SNS通知。然而，它无法直接检测Glue作业失败事 件，需要额外的逻辑来解析日志，操作复杂性较高。 结论：错误。

question: A company uses AWS Glue Apache Spark jobs to handle extract, transform, and load (ETL) workloads. The company has enabled logging and monitoring for all AWS Glue jobs. One of the AWS Glue jobs begins to fail. A data engineer investigates the error and wants to examine metrics for all individual stages within the job. How can the data engineer access the stage metrics?

options.A: Examine the AWS Glue job and stage details in the Spark UI.
options.B: Examine the AWS Glue job and stage metrics in Amazon CloudWatch.
options.C: Examine the AWS Glue job and stage logs in AWS CloudTrail logs.
options.D: Examine the AWS Glue job and stage details by using the run insights feature on the job.

explanations.A: Correct. AWS Glue使用Apache Spark作为其底层引擎，Spark UI提供了详细的作业和阶段信息，包括执行时间、任务分配等。这是查看 阶段详细信息的正确方法。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 虽然AWS Glue可以将作业的总体指标发送到Amazon CloudWatch，但CloudWatch并不提供Spark阶段级别的详细信息。
explanations.C: Incorrect. AWS CloudTrail主要用于记录API调用和用户活动日志，而不是用于查看Spark作业的阶段详细信息。
explanations.D: Incorrect. AWS Glue的运行洞察功能（Run Insights）提供的是作业级别的性能分析，而不是Spark阶段级别的详细信息。

question: A data engineer notices slow query performance on a highly partitioned table that is in Amazon Athena. The table contains daily data for the previous 5 years, partitioned by date. The data engineer wants to improve query performance and to automate partition management. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use an AWS Lambda function that runs daily. Configure the function to manually create new partitions in AWS Glue for each day’s data.
options.B: Use partition projection in Athena. Configure the table properties by using a date range from 5 years ago to the present.
options.C: Reduce the number of partitions by changing the partitioning schema from daily to monthly granularity.
options.D: Increase the processing capacity of Athena queries by allocating more compute resources.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：虽然使用AWS Lambda可以自动化分区创建，但手动创建分区并不能解决查询性能问题。分区投影是更高效的解决方案，因为 它避免了频繁的分区元数据更新。
explanations.B: Correct. 正确：分区投影允许Athena在查询时动态推断分区，而无需依赖AWS Glue元数据。这显著提高了查询性能，并简化了分区管理。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 错误：虽然减少分区数量可以改善性能，但改变分区粒度可能会影响数据的查询精度。如果用户需要按天查询数据，这种方法不可 行。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 错误：Athena是基于服务器无状态的查询服务，无法直接分配更多计算资源。性能优化应通过分区管理和查询设计来实现，而不是 增加计算资源。

question: A data engineer is using an Apache Iceberg framework to build a data lake that contains 100 ТВ of data. The data engineer wants to run AWS Glue Apache Spark jobs that use the Iceberg framework. What combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create a key named --conf for an AWS Glue job. Set Iceberg as a value for the --datalake-formats job parameter.
options.B: Specify the path to a specific version of Iceberg by using the -extra-jars job parameter. Set Iceberg as a value for the datalake-formats job parameter.
options.C: Set Iceberg as a value for the --datalake-formats job parameter.
options.D: Set the --enable-auto-scaling parameter to true.
options.E: Add the --job-bookmark-option: job-bookmark-enable parameter to an AWS Glue job.

explanations.A: Incorrect. AWS Glue作业中并 没有直接通过`--conf`键来设置数据湖格式的方式。正确的方式是通过`--datalake-formats`参数来指定数据湖格式。
explanations.B: Correct. 使用`-extra-jars`参数可以指定Iceberg框架的具体版本路径，这样可以确保AWS Glue作业能够加载正确的Iceberg库。 同时，设置`--datalake-formats`参数为Iceberg是正确的操作。
explanations.C: Correct. `--datalake-formats`参数用于指定数据湖的格式，Iceberg是支持 的格式之一，因此此选项是正确的。
explanations.D: Incorrect. `--enable-auto-scaling`参数用于启用AWS Glue作业的自动扩展功能，与Iceberg框 架的集成无关，因此此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.E: Incorrect. `--job-bookmark-option`参数用于启用作业书 签功能，以便跟踪作业的状态和增量数据处理，与Iceberg框架的集成无直接关系，因此此选项不符合题目要求。

question: A data engineer is configuring an AWS Glue Apache Spark extract, transform, and load (ETL) job. The job contains a sort-merge join of two large and equally sized DataFrames. The job is failing with the following error: No space left on device. Which solution will resolve the error?

options.A: Use the AWS Glue Spark shuffle manager.
options.B: Deploy are Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume for the job to use.
options.C: Convert the sort-merge join in the job to be a broadcast join.
options.D: Convert the DataFrames to DynamicFrames, and perform a DynamicFrame join in the job.

explanations.A: Correct. AWS Glue Spark shuffle manager是专门为AWS Glue优化的shuffle管理器，能够有效地管理中间数据的存储和传输，减少磁盘空间不足的 问题。 在sort-merge join中，shuffle操作会产生大量中间数据，使用Glue Spark shuffle manager可以优化这些操作。 此选项是解决问题的合理方法。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 增加EBS卷可以扩展磁盘空间，但AWS Glue作业通常运行在托管的环境中，无法直接控制底层的EBS卷配置。 此选项不适用于AWS Glue环境，因此是错误的。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 广播连接适用于一方数据较小的情况，因为广播连接会将较小的数据集分发到所有节点。如果两个DataFrame都很大且大小相近，广 播连接会导致内存不足问题。 此选项不适合当前场景，因此是错误的。
explanations.D: Incorrect. DynamicFrame是AWS Glue特有的数据结构，提供了更高层次的抽象和数据清理功能，但它并不会直接解决磁盘空间不足的问题。 此选项与问题无关，因此是错误的。

question: A company needs to implement a workflow to process transactions. Each transaction goes through multiple levels of validation. Each validation level depends on the preceding validation level. The workflow must either process or reject each transaction within 24-hours. The workflow must run for less than 24 hours total. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational cost?

options.A: Create a standard workflow in AWS Step Functions. Implement a Wait for Callback pattern to wait for the validation steps to finish.
options.B: Create an express workflow in AWS Step Functions. Implement a Wait for Callback pattern to wait for the validation steps to finish.
options.C: Use AWS Lambda functions to implement the workflow. Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke the validation steps.
options.D: Use Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA) to implement the workflow.

explanations.A: Correct. 标准工作流适用于长时间运行的任务，支持Wait for Callback模式，可以有效处理多级验证逻辑。 Step Functions的标准工作流按状态转换计费，适合需要24小时内完成的任务，且成本较低。 此选项满足题目要求，且操作成本较低。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 快速工作流适用于短时间运行的任务，通常在几秒到几分钟内完成。 快速工作流不适合长时间运行的任务（如24小时），因为其设计初衷是处理高吞吐量的短任务。 此选项不符合题目要求，且可能导致成本增加。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Lambda函数适合短时间运行的任务，最大执行时间为15分钟，无法满足24小时的工作流需求。 虽然EventBridge可以触发异步事件，但无法直接实现多级依赖的验证逻辑。 此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Amazon MWAA适合复杂的工作流管理，但其操作成本较高，且需要额外的配置和管理。 对于简单的多级验证逻辑，使用MWAA可能过于复杂，且不符合“最低操作成本”的要求。 此选项不符合题目要求。

question: A data engineer configures a large number of AWS Glue jobs that all start up around the same time. All the jobs run for less than 1 hour in the same subnet of the same VPC. All the AWS Glue jobs run on a G1.X worker type. Some of the jobs occasionally fail with the following error: "The specified subnet does not have enough free addresses to satisfy the request". What is the likely root cause of the error?

options.A: There are not enough IP addresses in the subnet.
options.B: The G1.X worker type cannot access the subnet.
options.C: AWS Glue does not have the correct IAM permissions to add additional IP addresses to the subnet.
options.D: There are not enough IP addresses in the VPC.

explanations.A: Correct. 这是最可能的原因。AWS Glue作业需要在VPC的子网中启动，并为每个worker分配一个IP地址。如果子网中的可用IP地址不足，就会 导致作业启动失败。 G1.X worker类型每个实例都需要一个独立的IP地址。如果多个作业同时启动，可能会耗尽子网中的IP地址。 因此，这个选项是正确的。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 这个选项是错误的。G1.X worker类型可以正常访问子网，只要子网配置正确并且有足够的IP地址。 题目中并未提到任何与worker类型无法访问子网相关的问题。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 这个选项是错误的。AWS Glue不会动态向子网添加IP地址，子网的IP地址是通过VPC和子网的CIDR块预先定义的，无法通过IAM权限 动态扩展。 因此，这个选项不符合题目描述。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 这个选项是错误的。题目明确提到问题发生在子网中，而不是整个VPC。即使VPC中有足够的IP地址，如果子网的CIDR块范围较小， 子网中的IP地址仍可能不足。 因此，这个选项不符合题目描述。

question: A company runs an Apache Spark application every night in an Amazon EMR cluster. The company uses Amazon EC2 instances to supply compute capacity for the EMR cluster. The company deployed the Spark application in cluster mode. An error occurs in the Spark application. A log for the error is stored in the application's Spark driver standard error logs. A data engineer needs to investigate the error. Where can the data engineer find this error log?

options.A: The engineer can connect to the web UI on the live cluster to see the YARN ResourceManager logs.
options.B: The engineer can connect to the persistent application UI to see the first YARN container log in the Spark UI.
options.C: The engineer can connect to the Amazon EMR console to see the Amazon EMR step logs that are archived in Amazon S3.
options.D: The engineer can connect to the primary node of the cluster by using SSH to see the Spark history server logs.

explanations.A: Incorrect. YARN ResourceManager日志主要记录资源调度相关的信息，而不是Spark driver的标准错误日志。 虽然可以通过YARN UI查看部分任务状态，但无法直接定位到Spark driver的错误日志。 因此此选项错误。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Spark UI可以提供任务执行的详细信息，但它不会直接存储Spark driver的标准错误日志。 此外，Spark UI中的日志通常是临时的，无法持久化存储。 因此此选项错误。
explanations.C: Correct. Amazon EMR会将步骤日志（包括Spark driver的标准错误日志）自动存储到Amazon S3中，前提是启用了日志存储功能。 通过EMR控制台可以方便地查看这些存储在S3中的日志。 此选项正确。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Spark history server主要用于查看已完成的Spark应用程序的执行历史，但它不会直接存储Spark driver的标准错误日志。 此外，连接到主节点需要额外的权限和配置，而不是最直接的方式。 因此此选项错误。

question: A company processes 500 GB of audience and advertising data daily, storing CSV files in Amazon S3 with schemas registered in AWS Glue Data Catalog. They need to convert these files to Apache Parquet format and store them in an S3 bucket. The solution requires a long-running workflow with 15 GiB memory capacity to process the data concurrently, followed by a correlation process that begins only after the first two processes complete. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA) to orchestrate the workflow by using AWS Glue. Configure AWS Glue to begin the third process after the first two processes have finished.
options.B: Use Amazon EMR to run each process in the workflow. Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to handle messages that indicate the completion of the first two processes. Configure an AWS Lambda function to process the SQS queue by running the third process.
options.C: Use AWS Glue workflows to run the first two processes in parallel. Ensure that the third process starts after the first two processes have finished.
options.D: Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate a workflow that uses multiple AWS Lambda functions. Ensure that the third process starts after the first two processes have finished.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 使用Amazon MWAA和AWS Glue： 正确性：Amazon MWAA（Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow）可以编排复杂的工作流，并支持与AWS Glue集成。但它需要额外的配 置和管理Airflow环境，增加了操作开销。 错误原因：虽然可以实现目标，但操作开销较高，不符合“最小化操作开销”的要求。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 使用Amazon EMR和SQS： 正确性：Amazon EMR可以处理大规模数据转换，SQS可以用于消息队列，Lambda可以触发后续任务。但这种方案需要管理EMR集 群、SQS队列和Lambda函数，增加了复杂性。 错误原因：操作开销较高，且需要额外的组件（SQS和Lambda），不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Correct. 使用AWS Glue Workflows： 正确性：AWS Glue Workflows可以直接编排工作流，支持并行处理和顺序执行，且与AWS Glue Data Catalog无缝集成。操作开销低，符 合题目要求。 正确原因：这是最简化的解决方案，直接满足题目要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 使用AWS Step Functions和Lambda： 正确性：AWS Step Functions可以编排工作流，Lambda可以处理数据转换。但Lambda的内存限制为10 GiB，无法满足15 GiB的需求。 错误原因：内存限制不满足要求，且需要额外管理Step Functions和Lambda，增加了操作开销。

question: A company uses an organization in AWS Organizations to manage multiple AWS accounts. The company uses an enhanced fanout data stream in Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to receive streaming data from multiple producers. The company runs the data stream in an account named Account A. The company wants to use an AWS Lambda function in an account named Account В to process the data from the data stream. The company creates a Lambda execution role in Account В that has permissions to access data from the data stream in Account A. What additional step must the company take to meet this requirement?

options.A: Create a service control policy (SCP) to grant the data stream read access to the cross-account Lambda execution role. Attach the SCP to Account A.
options.B: Add a resource-based policy to the data stream to allow read access for the cross-account Lambda execution role.
options.C: Create a service control policy (SCP) to grant the data stream read access to the cross-account Lambda execution role. Attach the SCP to Account B.
options.D: Add a resource-based policy to the cross-account Lambda function to grant the data stream read access to the function.

explanations.A: Incorrect. SCP 的作用是限制或允许账户级别的权限，但它不能直接授予资源访问权限。SCP无法直接赋予Lambda执行角色对Kinesis数据流的读取 权限，因此此选项不正确。
explanations.B: Correct. AWS支持通过资源基于策略（Resource- based Policy）来实现跨账户访问。将资源策略附加到Kinesis数据流，可以明确授予Account B中的Lambda执行角色对数据流的读取权 限。
explanations.C: Incorrect. SCP 的作用是限制或允许账户级别的权限，但它不能直接授予资源访问权限。SCP无法直接赋予Lambda执行角色对Kinesis数据流的读取 权限，因此此选项不正确。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Lambda函数的资源策略是用来控制谁 可以调用或管理该函数，而不是用来授予函数对其他资源（如Kinesis数据流）的访问权限。因此此选项不正确。

question: A company needs to use Amazon Athena to analyze data that is in an Amazon S3 bucket. A data engineer needs to configure AWS Glue table partitions for year, month, and day. The data engineer needs to create the partitions every day to adjust to schema changes in the data. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Glue DataBrew to create the partitions for the AWS Glue table.
options.B: Use an AWS Lambda function to create the partitions for the AWS Glue table.
options.C: Set partition projection properties for the AWS Glue table.
options.D: Configure an AWS Glue crawler to run on a set schedule.

explanations.A: Incorrect. 错误：AWS Glue DataBrew主要用于数据准备和清理，而不是用于管理表分区。它无法直接创建分区或管理分区属性。 因此此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 部分正确：AWS Lambda可以通过编写自定义代码来动态创建分区，但这种方法需要额外的开发和维护工作。 虽然可以满足需求，但并不是最优解，因为AWS Glue本身提供了更高效的分区管理功能。
explanations.C: Correct. 正确：分区投影是一种高效的分区管理方法，适用于分区结构固定且分区数量较大的场景。 通过设置分区投影属性，Athena可以直接查询分区数据，而无需每天更新分区信息。 此方法无需额外的计算资源，且能够自动适应分区变化，是最佳解决方案。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 部分正确：AWS Glue爬网程序可以自动检测数据的分区并更新表，但需要定期运行爬网程序，这会增加额外的计算成本。 相比分区投影，爬网程序的效率较低，且不适合每天频繁更新分区的场景。

question: A hotel management company receives daily data files from each of its hotels. The company wants to upload its data to AWS. The company plans to use Amazon Athena to access the files. The company needs to protect the files from accidental deletion. The company will develop an application on its on-premises servers to automatically forward the files to a fully managed AWS ingestion service. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
